commands: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; echo '=== HEAD ==='; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; echo '=== REMOTE BRANCHES ==='; git for-each-ref refs/remotes/origin --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname)' | sort

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== BRANCH RELATIONS ==='; for b in origin/main origin/feature/eink-clay-status origin/feature/eink-clay-status-chat-e23bf59b; do echo "--- $b"; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...$b || true; git merge-base origin/main $b || true; done; echo '=== FEATURE VS CHAT ==='; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/feature/eink-clay-status...origin/feature/eink-clay-status-chat-e23bf59b; git merge-base origin/feature/eink-clay-status origin/feature/eink-clay-status-chat-e23bf59b

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== DOC FILES ==='; git ls-files 'docs/**' | sort; echo '=== ROOT DOCS ==='; git ls-files '*.md' | sort; echo '=== DOC SIZES ==='; while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%7s %6s %s\n' "$(wc -c <"$f")" "$(wc -l <"$f")" "$f"; done < <(git ls-files 'docs/**' '*.md' | sort -u)

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== LIKELY DUPLICATE/HANDOFF REFERENCES ==='; rg -n 'FRESH_CHAT_BOOTSTRAP|CONTINUATION_PLAN|EINK_UI_HANDOFF|EINK_UI_NEW_CHAT_PROMPT|EINK_SCD41|ARCHITECTURE_HANDOFF|CURRENT_STATUS|PROJECT_ROADMAP' --glob '*.md' . || true; echo '=== DOC HEADINGS ==='; while IFS= read -r f; do echo "--- $f"; rg -m 8 '^#{1,3} ' "$f" || true; done < <(git ls-files 'docs/*.md' | sort)
